coreMemory.english: v. to offer an idea for someone to consider
coreMemory.structure: suggest doing /səˈdʒest duɪŋ/（建议做）；suggest that /səˈdʒest ðæt/（建议；表明……）；strongly suggest /strɔŋli səˈdʒest/（强烈建议）；evidence suggests /ɛvədəns sədʒɛsts/（证据表明）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to suggest → ✅ can suggest；❌ to suggesting → ✅ to suggest

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
